text:
Sanjay: Planning console web deploy (v2.9.1) tomorrow 08:30 PT. Main changes: split-css manifest bump and i18n bundles. Request: 10% canary for 15m, CDN invalidation for /static/*, and a quick smoke run. Who's on rollout + rollback?
Olivia: I can own canary + smoke. Will be online at 08:20 PT. Ping me 10m before start.
Elaine: I will handle CDN invalidation and edge priming. Suggest doing a small edge-warmup first for the critical JS/CSS. Command I plan to run: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1X2Y3Z4 --paths '/static/*' '/assets/*'`
Mike: I'll monitor RUM + SLOs for first-paint and interactive metrics. Watchlist: bundle size increase or 5xx spike. Rollback plan: revert traffic and restore previous asset prefix.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated: service/console -> image registry.redwood.ai/console:v2.9.1-canary; canary traffic=10%
Olivia: Smoke checklist (quick): login, workspace list, editor load, file upload. Will run those against canary and report.
Elaine: After invalidation I'll post edge-hit ratio and a small histogram of edge latency (~1m sample).
Mike: If median FCP > 2s for more than 5 minutes we rollback. Quick check to validate asset fingerprints: `curl -I https://console.redwood.ai/static/main.js | grep ETag` — confirm ETag matches the deployed fingerprint.
frontend-oncall: On standby at 08:20 PT for rollback actions. @Sanjay please paste the exact rollback command here before we start.
Sanjay: Rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/console console=registry.redwood.ai/console:v2.9.0 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/console` — shout here once executed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Canary reached 15m, health OK, no 5xx. Waiting on manual thumbs to push additional traffic.
Olivia: Thumbs from me. Proceed to 50% over next 5m, watch RUM closely.
Mike: Watching metrics now. No regressions so far.
Elaine: Invalidation finished, edge hit-rate warming. Posting sample logs in #eng-releases for visibility.
Sanjay: Moving to 50% then 100% if no issues in next 10m. Keep rollback channel open.
